dungeon.name: Contingency Contract
dungeon.desc:
- The operation comprises 3 consecutive enemy waves to fight. Defeat all enemy waves to complete the operation.
- Healing Masses will be dropped between the waves. Touch them to restore HP to every teammate.
- There is a resting session between waves, during which the operators are still considered to be in battle.
- The operation has a countdown timer. Once the timer ends or all operators in the team are reduced to ZERO HP, the operation is interrupted.
- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.

enemies.name: Tuskbeast Blightshade
enemies.desc: A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a tuskbeast. Although this is but a "lingering shadow", its sharp fangs are still capable of tearing through armor and protective gear.
enemies.ability: Some attacks can activate Blightshade Energy they hit.

enemies.name: Quillbeast Blightshade
enemies.desc: A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a quillbeast. This blightshade seems to exhibit far more aggressive rolling and bouncing attacks than its living counterpart, though it may just be a matter of imagination.
enemies.ability: After a short charge-up, the Quillbeast Blightshade can summon multiple bolts of lightning and activate Blightshade Energy within a large area. Interrupt the beast quickly when it starts charging up.

enemies.name: YSTF Captain Blightshade
enemies.desc: A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Captain. Only veterans who have demonstrated gifts for command, exceptional combat prowess, and achieved true valor in war will receive the chance of becoming a YSTF Captain.
enemies.ability:
After dissipating, this enemy can blink next to an operator and attack. Try to dodge.
The YSTF Captain Blightshade can use its weapon to call down thunderbolts. A Blightshade Energy entity is activated when hit by a thunderbolt.

enemies.name: Rockhowler
enemies.desc: Rockhowlers can live in the natural wilderness. These intelligent yet mischievous creatures often prepare "traps" and "dangers" for hapless travelers. They seem to enjoy the sight of humans frustrated by their antics. Please deal with them patiently.
enemies.ability: This enemy typically roams around in packs. The controlled operator or Rockhowler that steps on discarded banana peels will slip and fall.

enemies.name: Woodcraft Wanderer
enemies.desc: A small battle puppet created by a Snowpriestess. It is in charge of keeping the Snowy Forest safe. Do not underestimate its fists of wood, for they can smash through stone with hardly any effort.
enemies.ability:
A Woodcraft Wanderer with zero shield stacks will trap operators to absorb their energy and restore its shield stacks.
Woodcraft Wanderers will work with each other when attacking.

enemies.name: Armored Manglerbeast
enemies.desc: A variant of manglerbeasts that evolved specifically on Talos-II. These unique manglers are armored in extremely thick scales and share a mutualistic symbiosis with rockhowlers. The former species provides the bulwark and muscle while the latter offers keen senses and warns against trespassers.
enemies.ability:
The Rockhowler riding on the Armored Manglerbeast's back can throw banana peels.
Drops Rockhowlers when knocked down. Attack the Rockhowlers to deal even more DMG.

enemies.name: Cloud Obliterator
enemies.desc: A criminal equipped with heavy weaponry. Obliteration is no small feat. Only the strongest smashers armed with quadruple rocket launchers can achieve the title of Cloud Obliterator.
enemies.ability:
Uses the heavy rocket launcher as a melee weapon. Also shoots fireworks for its ranged attacks. Getting rammed and lifted by its horns might set off some super fireworks!
Don't try to backstab it. It has a powerful hind kick!
